title: Is the Moon leaving us?
old_caption:
No fight. We just stopped texting.
The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm a year, and most friendships drift just as quietly. The pull back is small too: one text.

title: Why do stars twinkle but planets don't?
old_caption:
Sparkly one week, gone the next.
Stars twinkle because of the moving air between us, not the star. Mixed signals are often static too: skip the guessing and ask one clear question.

title: Is the North Star the brightest star?
old_caption:
Plot twist: the North Star isn't the brightest one up there.
It's famous because it stays put while the whole sky turns. Keep the people you can find in the dark.

title: Why can't I see my sign on my birthday?
old_caption:
Looked up on my birthday and my sign wasn't even there.
The Sun is parked in front of it all day. If you want a fuss, say so out loud: people can't read the sky in your head.

title: Why do shooting stars come back every December?
old_caption:
Wished on every shooting star that they'd text me.
Each December Earth crosses the same trail of space dust. A wish is a lovely start; the brave, kind part is texting first.

title: Aries vs Libra: Fastest Buzzer Loses
old_caption:
Aries buzzed before the question existed. Libra needed a minute to pick a flag. Somehow it ended in a tie, and the front row is still crying.
Who are you on game night: the buzzer or the ponderer?

title: Leo vs Sagittarius: Zero Inside Voices
old_caption:
Two fire signs, one stage, zero volume control. Sag won on honesty, and Leo still led the standing ovation.
Which fire sign do you want in your corner after a breakup?

title: Taurus vs Scorpio: The Staring Round
old_caption:
Nobody blinked, nobody buzzed, and the host had to ask twice. Then Scorpio opened the vault, just a little.
Tag the friend who keeps every secret forever.

title: Virgo vs Capricorn: Clipboards Out
old_caption:
Two clipboards walked onto a game show. Virgo won by forgiving a forgotten coffee order, and Capricorn handed over a gold star like a true professional.
What's your coffee order, and does your person know it?

title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: Yes or Yes
old_caption:
"Yes or yes?" is not a question, Sagittarius. Gemini took the round by asking about the homebody's favorite night in.
Are you the plan-maker or the plan-joiner?
